GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then tightened and hampered, Settled Down 9 Lengths on fence, railed up to 7 Lengths turning, made a little ground in straight. [Stewards: Rider reported that, after being tightened at the start, it settled further back than intended, travelled fairly early/middle stages but proved disappointing when placed under pressure.] # never featured
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Tightened on leaving the gates. Rdr reported after being tightened at start, mount settled further back than expected-added gelding travelled fairly in the early and middle stages, however, when placed under pressure, proved disappointing.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back a length middle stages, Hooked Out to 4 Lengths 3 Wide turning, steered centre of track Straightening Up and ran on hitting narrow Lead at 175m, battled on wel to the line. [Stewards: COT - To settle further forward. Settled behind the leaders.] # battled on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: C/O/T-further forward. Settled behind the leaders. Laid in under pressure in the home straight and near the 100m Rdr dropped near side rein.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn 2.5 Lengths rail, Held Up rounding turn then blocked all the way down the straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. App. jockey stated he was instructed to ride it where comfortable, it settled midfield, travelled well early/middle stages, he pressured it from 600m however it improved up onto heels, was held up and unable to improved, going to the line untested.] # never got out
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running from the 400m until round home turn when steadied and became unbalanced when tightened for room. Held up for clear running from the 200m and unable to improve until the 50m. Rdr stated instructed to ride gelding where comfortable-said mount settled in a midfield position and travelled well in early and middle stages-added began to place mount under pressure from the 600m; however, improved up onto heels & was held up for most of remainder of race & went to end of race without being tested.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled touch better Mid Field rails 5 Lengths 800m, weaved to Middle Of Track soon after Straightening Up and let down, Kept Coming last 100m but Just ran out of ground and had to settle for close second spot, wins next stride # wins next stride

Jumped okay & Went Forward to lead on fence by a half length, Held Together in front & led by a head turning, joined 400m, narrowly Headed Straightening Up , kept fighting all the way to the post # lost in headbobber

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , held together much same to turn 2 Lengths Two Wide , shifted 3 Wide Straightening Up and ran on hitting Lead at the 140m, Headed in the final strides # Had run of the race

Jumped Ok , enjoyed good trail Two Wide With Cover behind speed 3 Lengths 800m, started to weaved a package before corner and got to Middle Of Track soon after Straightening Up , let down last 200m and finished too well for impressive win # finished too well
Jumped Ok , scrubbed along touch Worse than midfield Two Wide 6 Lengths 700m, Ridden Along soon after Straightening Up , did keep grinding away last 200m without getting close # grinding effort
Jumped Ok , Settled Mid Field rails 5 Lengths 700m, worked off fence soon after Straightening Up but Ridden Along , only one paced in Straight , winkers first time # one paced

Jumped well didn't push on settled down worse Mid Field Two Wide 5 Lengths (1000m), shoved along 500 back to last & same for home going absolutely nowhere, Not Knocked About to the line (Winkers FIRST TIME) # didn't handle going
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported mount was not suited to track conditions.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 7th Inside 7 Lengths Fast Pace on, and Inside winner early , Clear All The Way had its chance was flat @ 400m, # did nothing
Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 8 Lengths turning, lost further ground in Straight # never a factor
